probe.title: Bouquet Infusions
probe.text_sample: Bouquet Infusions Find us About FLAVOR ARRANGEMENT ATELIER Home About Find Us Instagram Bouquet creates flavor-forward infusions with the highest quality ingredients — syrups for grown-ups. Bold flavors with less sweetness, and no artificial anything. More room for good stuff, no room for compromise. For cafés, cocktails, or even a humble glass of sparkling water. About Bouquet Our Syrups Orange Marmalade Notes of steeped orange rind, juicy OJ, and hint of orange blossom balanced with smooth Madagascar vanilla. A tonic for any season. Explore Brown Butter Caramel Notes of browned butter and turbinado sugar toasted into savory, slightly salty caramel. Sometimes, a little bitter is better. Explore Vanilla Fleur de Sel Vanilla meets fleur de sel, revealing warm, floral, and woody notes while balancing sweetness. A whisper of salt makes vanilla bloom. Explore Green Cardamom Complex notes of green cardamom: aromatic spice from seeds, bright citrus and floral from pods. Just the spice to spice things up. Explore What's happening?
